title: 第21章 副殿主第22章 能去别处打吗打扰到我了
slug: 杂役都是仙帝你管这叫没落宗门
lines: 恐怖的剑罡，横扫而过，二十余位王境，陨——！
目睹这一幕的人，无不震撼。
那可是……二十位王境啊！
不远处，严氏所在，严氏二长老苦涩开口，这一刻他才明白，族长拦他，原来是在救他。
严嵩摇了摇头，心中的震撼，不比任何人小。
他知道林玄很强，毕竟当初在暮月拍卖行亲眼见识过，但他也没想到，林玄会强到这等地步……
离开绿洲后，林玄便是开始漫无目的的在沙漠之中游荡，同时恢复自身伤势。
天劫所造成的创伤，非短时间内恢复，想要恢复到全盛时期，至少需要一天乃至几天时间。
但多恢复一分，他在秘境中的自保能力也将多一分。
突破王境、灵泉到手后，林玄倒也不着急了。
即便接下来再无任何收获，他此趟秘境之行的收获也已经完全超出预期了。
接下来林玄便没有了此前的好运气，连续几个时辰过去了也没有再遇到什么机缘，倒是碰到了几个……试图抢夺他的修士……
“小子，将身上的所有东西交出来！”几个地玄境修士，分别堵住了林玄的所有退路。
伤势还未恢复，林玄此刻的气息十分虚弱，甚至不如地玄境，这也是几人盯上林玄的原因。
“如果不交呢？”林玄笑了。
几个地玄境，实在太弱了，弱到他都懒得出手。
为首之人冷哼一声，直接动手！
然而就在此时，一道剑气自远方袭来！瞬间将那欲要对林玄出手的地玄境修士轰飞了出去！
“我青阳剑宗弟子，也是你们能抢的？”
顺着声音望去，不远处，数道身影飞速掠来，有男有女，她们身上所穿的服饰，和林玄身上一般无二，显然都是青阳剑宗门人！
林玄刚抬起的手，则缓缓放了下去。
青阳剑宗弟子，是指自己吗？
不过想了想，林玄也就明白了。
他虽是星陨峰峰主，但自几年前出了南宫邀月那档子事后，他便很少在宗内露面，以至于大部分这几年期间加入宗门的新弟子，只知晓有星陨峰主这个人，却未见过其真容。
青阳剑宗几人中，一位年龄略大的温婉女子，一声轻呵，怒视着那被其刚才一剑轰飞之人。
“点子背，走——！”
几人自知不是对手，顿时落荒而逃。
临走前，还不忘狠狠瞪了林玄一眼，仿佛是在说，算你运气好。
可事实，真的是林玄运气好吗？
“这位师弟，你没事吧？”
几名青阳剑宗弟子中，隐隐以那温婉女子为首，眼看着几人落荒而逃后，她顿时转过身来，对林玄关切问道。
林玄摇了摇头，心中却是十分怪异。
师弟？
不过话说回来，自从突破王境后，寿元大涨，看起来确实是要比她年轻一些。
content_en:
The terrifying sword gang swept past, and more than twenty kings died——!
Everyone who witnessed this scene was shocked.
That's... twenty kings!
"Clan leader, I..."
Not far away, where the Yan family was, the second elder of the Yan family spoke bitterly. Only at this moment did he understand that the clan leader was trying to save him when he stopped him.
Yan Song shook his head, the shock in his heart was no less than that of anyone else.
He knew that Lin Xuan was very strong. After all, he had seen it with his own eyes at Muyue Auction House, but he did not expect that Lin Xuan would be so strong...
After leaving the oasis, Lin Xuan began to wander aimlessly in the desert while recovering from his injuries.
The trauma caused by the catastrophe cannot be recovered in a short time. It will take at least a day or even a few days to return to its heyday.
But the more he recovers, the more he will be able to protect himself in the secret realm.
After breaking through to the King Realm and obtaining the spiritual spring, Lin Xuan was not in a hurry.
Even if there is no more harvest in the future, his harvest from this trip to the secret realm has completely exceeded expectations.
Then Lin Xuan lost his previous good luck. Several hours passed without encountering any opportunities. Instead, he encountered a few... monks who tried to rob him...
"Boy, hand over everything you have on you!" Several Earth Profound Realm monks blocked all Lin Xuan's escape routes.
The injury has not yet recovered, and Lin Xuan's aura is very weak at the moment, not even as good as the Earth Profound Realm. This is why several people are eyeing Lin Xuan.
"What if I don't hand it over?" Lin Xuan smiled.
Several of the Earth Profound Realms were so weak that he didn't even bother to take action.
"Then die——!"
The leader snorted coldly and took action directly!
"Tsk-!"
However, at this moment, a sword energy struck from afar! In an instant, the Earthly Profound Realm cultivator who was about to attack Lin Xuan was blasted away!
"I, a disciple of the Qingyang Sword Sect, can you rob me too?"
Looking along the sound, not far away, several figures quickly passed by, including men and women. The clothes they wore were the same as those worn by Lin Xuan. They were all members of the Qingyang Sword Sect!
The hand Lin Xuangang raised slowly lowered it.
A disciple of the Qingyang Sword Sect, do you mean yourself?
But after thinking about it, Lin Xuan understood.
Although he is the master of Xingyun Peak, he has rarely appeared in the sect since he left Nangong Yaoyue's stall a few years ago. As a result, most of the new disciples who joined the sect in the past few years only know that the master of Xingyun Peak is there, but have never seen his true face.
"Get out!"
Among the members of the Qingyang Sword Sect, a slightly older and gentle woman let out a soft chuckle and glared angrily at the person who had been blown away by her sword just now.
"Memory the idea, let's go——!"
Knowing that they were no match, several people immediately fled.
Before leaving, he did not forget to give Lin Xuan a hard look, as if to say, you are lucky.
But in fact, is Lin Xuan really lucky?
"Junior brother, are you okay?"
Among the several Qingyang Sword Sect disciples, the gentle woman was vaguely headed. After seeing several people fleeing, she immediately turned around and asked Lin Xuan with concern.
Lin Xuan shook his head, feeling very strange in his heart.
Junior brother?
But having said that, since breaking through to the King Realm, her longevity has increased significantly, and she does look younger than her.
